name: GridListColDef
description: Column Definition interface used for the list view column.

entries.name: field
entries.description: The unique identifier of the column. Used to map with [[GridRowModel]] values.

entries.name: cellClassName
entries.description: Class name added to cells in this column.

entries.name: display
entries.description:
Display mode for the cell:
 - 'text': For text-based cells (default)
 - 'flex': For cells with HTMLElement children

entries.name: renderCell
entries.description: Override the component rendered as cell for this column.

tags.param: params Object containing parameters for the renderer.
